name: Decoupled Toolbox for Weight
description: Makes Weight compatible with Decoupled Toolbox.
project_description: Decoupled Toolbox for Weight is a sub-module of Decoupled Toolbox. Makes Weight compatible with Decoupled Toolbox. It ships a single decoupled field formatter (plugin `decoupled_weight`, class `WeightDecoupledFormatter`) so that weight fields can be placed on the Decoupled view mode and serialized to JSON by the parent module's collection endpoint. Requires the contrib Weight module. Extends `GenericDecoupledFormatter`.
